newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Process Q3 revenue $37 mln.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Process Q3 revenue $37 mln.

text.p: Integrated Process Equipment Corp said its third quarter revenues were about $37 million compared to sales of about $50.5 million in the year-ago third quarter.
Its backlog for the nine months ended March 31 was about $102 million, the company said.
Backlog at March 31 was about $54 million compared to backlog of about $49 million at December 31, the company said.
The company, which supplies chemical-mechanical planarization systems used in semiconductor manufacture, said it would release other financial data on or about April 28.
